answer: PUF-tethered epoch tickets: each agent submits a fresh physically unclonable function (PUF) response to a random reef beacon challenge at every zenith checkpoint, signing a marble state root. Copied keys fail because responses are chip-specific; a clone needs a distinct PUF die. Per-PUF payouts are capped below device, calibration, enrollment, and checkpoint-latency costs, making the marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
